svg.text: Smart Parking (ESP32). Bright = do it now, faded = already done.
1. Sensor pins in 10a (VCC), 11a (Trig), 12a (Echo), 13a (GND), eyes facing the slot
2. Wires: 10e -> RED (+) rail, 13e -> BLUE (-) rail, 11e -> ESP32 D5 (Trig)
3. 1k ohm: 12c -> 16c. 2k ohm: 16d -> 20d. Wire 20e -> BLUE (-) rail. Wire 16e -> ESP32 D18 (Echo)
